_readme: Approved Sales Coach script, word for word. '|' marks phrase breaks only (not spoken): each phrase is synthesised separately and joined with a natural pause; captions follow the measured phrase timings. `offset` = seconds after the scene starts.

voice.direction: Young adult female, Indian English. Warm, conversational, confident, human; professional but not corporate-advert.

lines.text: Every customer meeting begins long before you enter the room. | But getting ready isn't always easy.
Information is everywhere. | Reports, account history, updates. | But what actually matters for this conversation?
What if your meeting brief could do more than just show information? | Meet Sales Coach.

See your upcoming conversations, | understand the account, | and get the context that matters — all in one place. | Need to go deeper? Just ask. | With voice-first AI, get answers without losing the context of your work.
And preparation doesn't stop there. | Practise realistic customer conversations, respond to questions, | and get feedback before the actual meeting.
From understanding to practising, Sales Coach helps you walk into every conversation better prepared. | Sales Coach. Be ready for what matters.
